name: Runoff
reason: We got a decent 47 mm over two weeks, but only the one heavy day, so the fields sent some nutrients down without a big flush, and with early July warmth a bloom could be getting started but I wouldn't bet the farm on it.
evidence: rain_last_14d_mm: 47.4 is a moderate amount, enough to move some litter and fertilizer
heavy_rain_days: 1 means just one real washout event, not a string of them
Early July timing fits the one-to-two week lag after that rain for warm, settled water
